# Example of Palindrome

#### Course: Learn Recursion With C++

## Example of Palindrome

In this example, we will create a program to check if a string is a palindrome or not.

A palindrome is a string that spells the same forward and backward. For example, "pullup" is a palindrome because:

1. The first and the last characters are the same.
2. The second and the second-last characters are the same.
3. The third and the third-last characters are the same.

![A Palindrome With Even Number of Characters](data:image/png;base64,)

In the case of a string with an odd number of characters (such as "level"), we will have one remaining character.

The "level" string is a palindrome because:

1. The first and the last characters are the same.
2. The second and the second-last characters are the same.
3. There is a single character left, v.

![A Palindrome With Odd Number of Characters](data:image/png;base64,)
